acceptance_rule: All reopened and new gating requirements must be PASS, the 30 unaffected v1 PASS requirements must remain covered by the complete regression suite, the historical D0 validator must pass at its accepted checkpoint while the four authoritative D0 anchors remain unchanged in the current tree, current guidance must state the D1-v2/D2 boundary, and every real predictive operation remains forbidden.

reopened_and_new_requirements.evidence: The authoritative D0 plan, reference, registry and manifest retain their accepted hashes in the current tree. The D1 validator reconstructs exact Git blobs at accepted D0 checkpoint cbddb4ff13f4452aa37f427f0f3c09a3f3da1ae4 and requires that checkpoint's D0 validator to return PASS. The historical whole-repository manifest is not applied to mutable current guidance.

ModelMatrix, ModelTarget and ModelScores carry the same sealed ordered ledger over candidate_run_id, contract_version, decision_session and security_id. Registry-pinned semantic-row hashes, fit-time exact-ledger equality, score propagation, bound-frame accessors and adversarial reorder/mismatch tests fail closed. The structural builder now reads only session_date from the manifest-pinned validated WIG and decision_session from the pinned market-state artifact. It fails on either mismatch. The accepted inputs prove 1,915/1,915 candidate-range WIG sessions and 1,663/1,663 official-membership/market-state sessions with equal ordered hashes.

The supported command is `python -m ats_ml validate-structural --run-dir <explicit-run-dir>`. It returns PASS for phase-d1-structural-b4fb9bbc480c2026e423, and the D1 validator invokes this exact CLI rather than only calling the Python function.

Focused D1: 67 passed; supported source/python suite: 174 passed; pre-Phase-D market-state: 10 passed; historical Phase D0 validator at cbddb4ff13f4452aa37f427f0f3c09a3f3da1ae4: PASS; corrected structural CLI: PASS; the accepted structural run retains identical logical and physical identities.
